delivery: Unique packets received at their intended end destination / generated packets; pending and rejected packets remain in the denominator.
timely_delivery: Unique packets received before the specified model-time deadline / all generated packets. Heartbeat 2000ms, alarm 1000ms, ordinary/control 5000ms.
command_success: A successful return status received at ground; command enqueue or link ACK alone is not execution success.
p95: Upper edge of the 10ms histogram bin containing the 95th percentile, across delivered packets; overflow is explicitly bounded separately from maximum delay.
ber: Compared errors / tested bits in captured/decoded frames. Uncaptured frames have no BER sample; they remain failures in capture and delivery rates.
hop_success: DATA confirmed by ACK / DATA attempts, separately from physical direction and ACK waveform attempts.
ack_failures: DATA decoded but a valid affirmative ACK was not received, including receiver rejection responses.
goodput: Unique end-delivered application payload bits / model elapsed seconds, not UART bandwidth or radio throughput.
capacity: Measured sustainable offered application load under explicitly fixed topology, frame size, TDMA, FEC and channel conditions; not Shannon capacity or a universal device limit.
evm: Frame-averaged reference RMS error after receiver processing; known TX symbols feed only a separate measurement monitor, never receiver decisions.
scene_reference: Geometry and controlled channel parameters; not measurements of the real atmosphere.
hardware_endpoint: Nodes 9 and 13 own independent FPGA source queues, heartbeat/sequence state, decoded command execution, acknowledgements and isolated reset. Fourteen other UAV nodes are ARM software contexts. Every waveform uses one shared FPGA PHY core. Board-internal endpoints are the user-approved single-board scope, not two external aircraft or boards.
external_endpoint: No physical external-node connection is claimed. External second-board integration is deferred by user instruction.
